r_call: confint.gllvmTMB_multi(object, parm='rho:unit:1,2', method=<'wald_asym'|'bogus'>) -> .confint_rho(method=...) -> else-branch -> cli_abort('Method ... not supported for rho. Available: fisher-z, wald, bootstrap.'). tier='unit' avoids the separate unit_slope/cluster/cluster2 early-abort branches; .parse_rho_parm validates the tier string only, and the method else-branch never calls extract_correlations. NOTE: fisher-z IS a valid rho method in R (CI-ROUTE-034, bound in wave2 as CORE070-INFERENCE-RHO-CI-METHOD-ROUTE); this case therefore covers only wald_asym and bogus, not fisher-z.
julia_surface: correlation_wald_ci(fit, i, j; method=<bad>) -- declares no `method` keyword, raises MethodError
check: for each of the 2 bad method strings: R raises an error whose message contains 'not supported' and 'rho'; Julia raises MethodError
